messages:
laura: quick note from my review of the audit-exports docs 097 snippets use different retention fields and one example includes full prompt text. SOC2 flag.

mike: oof. which fields? i see `expires_at` in node, `ttl_seconds` in py, and `retentionDays` in ruby.

samir: propose we standardize on `retention_period_days` (int) in examples. clear, language-agnostic, easy to document.

security: please remove any example that shows raw prompt content. replace with `prompt_id: "p_..."` and call out admin lookup requiring approval.

compliance: wording guidance: say "retained for N days" and add "subject to legal hold or manual review". avoid words like "forever".

mike: i'll open a small follow-up PR to: 1) update snippets to `retention_period_days`, 2) swap raw prompt -> `prompt_id`, 3) update the field table on audit-exports.

devex-bot: PR #4378 created by mike - "docs: align retention snippet names; pseudonymize prompt examples" - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4378

laura: thanks. samir, can you add a short docs lint check to grep for `prompt_text:` to prevent regressions?

samir: yep will add a simple check and a tiny unit that validates example fields against the canonical audit schema. ETA EOD.

mike: pinging @security and @compliance in the PR description for sign-off. will squash-merge once green and include CHANGELOG note: "docs(security): harmonize retention snippets; remove raw prompt example; clarify export approval"

laura: perfect. small but important cleanup for clarity and audit readiness.
